title: Frontend Developer (Vue.js)
description: As a Frontend Developer at PixelForge Labs, you will be responsible for designing and implementing modern, scalable, and maintainable user interfaces using Vue.js and related technologies. You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver seamless user experiences. The ideal candidate is passionate about UI/UX, has a keen eye for detail, and thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment. You will also have the opportunity to mentor junior developers and contribute to our design system.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description: Join DataSprint as a Backend Engineer and play a key role in architecting, developing, and optimizing our core backend systems. You will work with Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS to build robust APIs and scalable microservices. You will be expected to drive best practices in code quality, security, and performance, and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver mission-critical features. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure is highly valued.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: As a Full Stack Developer at NextGen Softworks, you will work on diverse client projects, building and maintaining both frontend and backend components. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust web applications using React, Node.js, and MongoDB. The role offers flexible hours and the opportunity to work remotely, making it ideal for self-motivated developers who thrive in dynamic environments. Experience with cloud platforms and agile methodologies is a plus.

title: Junior QA Tester
description: As a Junior QA Tester at BugTrackr, you will assist in testing web applications, identifying bugs, and ensuring product quality. You will work closely with developers and product managers to create and execute test cases, document issues, and verify bug fixes. This internship is ideal for candidates looking to start a career in software testing, offering mentorship, hands-on experience, and the possibility of a pre-placement offer for outstanding performers.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Join DesignNest as a UI/UX Designer and help shape the user experience of our web and mobile applications. You will conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and collaborate with developers to implement visually appealing and user-friendly designs. The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about solving user problems through design. Experience with Figma and Adobe XD is required.

title: Product Manager
description: As a Product Manager at InnoTech, you will lead the development and execution of product strategies, working closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams. You will define product roadmaps, gather and prioritize requirements, and ensure timely delivery of high-impact features. The role requires strong leadership, communication, and analytical skills, as well as experience with agile methodologies and stakeholder management.

title: Mobile App Developer (Flutter)
description: Appify is seeking a skilled Mobile App Developer with expertise in Flutter and Dart to create high-quality, cross-platform mobile applications. You will be responsible for the full app development lifecycle, from concept to deployment, and will work closely with designers and backend engineers. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver pixel-perfect UIs. Experience with Firebase and publishing apps to app stores is a plus.

title: Technical Writer
description: As a Technical Writer at DocuPro, you will create, edit, and maintain comprehensive documentation for our products and APIs. You will work with engineers and product managers to ensure accuracy and clarity in all technical materials. The ideal candidate has excellent written communication skills, a knack for explaining complex concepts simply, and experience with Markdown and API documentation tools. Remote work and flexible hours are available.

title: Data Analyst
description: InsightIQ is seeking a Data Analyst to join our analytics team. You will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing large datasets to generate actionable business insights. The role involves creating dashboards, preparing reports, and collaborating with business stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making. Proficiency in SQL, Python, and Tableau is essential, along with strong problem-solving and communication skills.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description: Design and implement cloud solutions for clients.

title: AI Research Intern
description: Assist in AI research projects and experiments.

title: Sales Executive
description: Drive sales and manage client relationships.

title: Security Analyst
description: SecureNet is looking for a Security Analyst to join our growing cybersecurity team. You will monitor security alerts, investigate incidents, and implement response strategies to protect our infrastructure and data. The role involves working with SIEM tools, conducting vulnerability assessments, and collaborating with IT teams to improve security posture. Candidates should have a strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, incident response, and regulatory compliance.
